dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 28, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Angels Soar Past Tigers, Acuña Jr. Powers Braves to Win"

The Los Angeles Angels cruised to a 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Zach Neto, Mike Trout, and Donovan Walton leading the charge. Neto drove in a pair of runs, while Trout doubled to score two runs. Jack Flaherty struggled on the mound, allowing three earned runs in 5.2 innings, but Grayson Rodriguez earned the win. In other action, Ronald Acuña Jr. homered and drove in four runs to power the Atlanta Braves to a 10-2 win over the Boston Red Sox. Chris Sale also had a strong outing, striking out eight in five innings.
